blocks.text: The narrative shifts into the Salodi episode, introducing Aali Singh and the world around Sirhind in which fear, service, and resentment still bind people to the nawab’s establishment.
Aali Singh becomes the key figure here: pressured by power yet inwardly unsettled, he stands at the edge between obedience to Sirhind and attraction to the Guru’s cause.
This page makes Aali Singh the hinge through which a local story turns toward Khalsa affiliation.
